blocks.html:
Welcome to the eLab website, the USI eLearning service!

The primary objective of the eLab is to improve the quality of teaching at USI through the integration of digital technologies and the promotion of innovative teaching methods. To pursue this mission, the eLab can count on an interdisciplinary and highly qualified team with proven expertise in university teaching, instructional design, educational technologies, informatics and web development. The team also draws on experts in communication, video production, graphic design, and digital law (CCDigitalLaw). This integrated approach allows us to offer comprehensive support to the USI academic community.

The lab provides USI students, faculty, and staff with the necessary infrastructure and support services, and is available for collaboration with other services or external entities.

Please consult the rest of our website for more information on areas and methods of support, training opportunities, upcoming events, and eLab projects.

Start of the autumn semester 2026

On this page, USI lecturers can find useful information on how to use the iCorsi platform and the other tools made available to them, and how to have their students take examinations at the PC at the end of the semester: Directions for the start of the autumn semester 2026.

Online Workshop "Make It Stick - How to Activate Students"

As part of the EASE (Educational Academic Staff Empowerment) project, eLab is offering an online workshop, designed in collaboration with the University of Bern, on student engagement and activation in class.

The workshop is aimed at all USI lecturers and teaching assistants and will be held via Zoom on Thursday, September 17, from 9:00 am to 3:30 pm. For more information and to register, click here

Brown Bag Lunches 2026/27

The new series of Brown Bag Lunches for 2026/27 will focus on "Activating Students: Creating the Conditions for Learning".
The sessions, organized in collaboration between eLab and SEDIFO, are open to all academic and administrative staff at USI and SUPSI.
More info at: https://www.usi.ch/it/universita/info/elab/attivita-formative/brown-bag-lunches

eLab's annual report 2024-25

The annual report on the main activities carried out by eLab during the academic year 2024–25 has been published and is available here (in Italian only): Rapporto annuale eLab 2024-25.

eLab aims to help USI lecturers and assistants integrate digital technologies into their teaching activities in a fruitful and effective way, keeping the focus not on technologies, which are constantly being updated, but on learning and the people who learn: the "e" in front of the word "learning" is intended to imply that technologies are at the service of learning and not vice versa!
